definitions.explanation: A legal term meaning a crime that has been fully carried out, with all elements of the offense completed. Contrasted with {未遂|みすい} (attempted but not completed). Used in criminal law, court judgments, and news reporting on criminal cases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧{既遂|きすい}。
⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧{既遂|きすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}→起訴：10577_kiso⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was indicted on a charge of consummated fraud.

examples.japanese: {既遂|きすい}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Whether the crime was consummated or merely attempted greatly changes the severity of the sentence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧{既遂|きすい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧し、⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}した→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧。
examples.english: The court found the defendant's act to be consummated robbery and sentenced him to ten years in prison.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{既|き}→既〜：28657_ki⟧ (already) and {遂|すい} (to accomplish; to carry through). Literally "already accomplished," contrasted with ⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧ "not yet accomplished."

USAGE:
A specialized legal term. Most commonly appears attached to the name of a specific crime: ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧{既遂|きすい} (consummated murder), ⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧{既遂|きすい} (consummated robbery), ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧{既遂|きすい} (consummated fraud). Virtually never used outside legal and crime-reporting contexts. The distinction {既遂|きすい} vs. ⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧ is important because Japanese criminal law allows lighter sentences for attempted crimes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧{既遂|きすい}: consummated murder
- {既遂|きすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧: the crime of a consummated offense
- {既遂|きすい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to determine (a crime) to be consummated
- {既遂|きすい}{犯|はん}: perpetrator of a consummated crime

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧: attempted (but not completed) — the direct antonym, used when the perpetrator fails to complete the crime
- ⟦{予備|よび}→予備：03993_yobi⟧: preparation (of a crime) — an even earlier stage, punishable only for certain serious offenses
- ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧: execution; carrying out — the general act of committing, not specifically the completed state
